name: Venonis
text: Archaeological site in Leicestershire, United Kingdom.

depictions.name: Venonis
depictions.text: High Cross, Leicestershire Venonis was the name of the ruins of a former Roman settlement situated in Leicestershire, England, then part of the Roman province of Britannia. Redwalda, a Zealot serving under the Order of the Ancients, patrolled the ruins as part of his routine. In the late 9th century, the Viking Eivor Varinsdottir of the Raven Clan explored these ruins, finding within it one carbon ingot, a book of knowledge, a Roman artifact, a treasure map and the Hrafn Guard shield.
